title: Phased announcement, content-freeze and staffing plan for Adaptive Routing GA
creator: Nora Patel
description: Orchestrate a staged cross-channel announcement for Adaptive Routing reaching GA. This ticket coordinates the content-freeze windows, release notes alignment, email segmentation and send windows, social calendar, and webinar logistics. Objective: ensure customers see consistent messaging across blog, docs, email, social, and the webinar while reducing last-minute copy/design churn and making on-call/resolution staffing explicit for launch week.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized release notes in Docs with migration/compat guidance and example config snippets
Marketing blog post copy approved by PM and Design, scheduled in CMS with publish time aligned to API rollout
Email campaigns segmented (trial users, active integrators, enterprise contacts) with send windows and suppression lists defined
Social calendar created with assets and thread-level embargoes; creative files stored in drive link above
Webinar scheduled, speaker slate confirmed, rehearsal planned, and registration page live with tracking UTM parameters
Coverage plan for support/on-call with a staffed rotation for the 72-hour post-GA window
Content-freeze gates defined and enforced: docs/design freeze 3 business days before GA, copy freeze 2 business days before GA
